name: sitegloss
description: Mark what is wrong on a web page, open the marks in another environment to fix it, and talk them through with your AI app
author: Jean-Pierre Bergamin <james@ractive.ch>

scripts.verify: biome ci . && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: bun check -p tsconfig.json && bun check -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:server: SITEGLOSS_E2E=full bun test --timeout 30000 test/cloud-server.test.ts test/e2e/cloud.test.ts test/e2e/firefox/cloud.test.ts
